callGraph.callee:
[
    name.padEnd(13),
    String(value.trades).padStart(5),
    `${(100 * value.winRate).toFixed(1)}%`.padStart(7),
    value.expectancy.toFixed(3).padStart(8),
    signed(value.grossR).padStart(9),
    signed(value.netR).padStart(9),
    signed(-value.costR).padStart(9),
    `${(100 * value.maxDrawdown).toFixed(1)}%`.padStart(8),
    value.tradesPerDay.toFixed(2).padStart(7),
    value.avgHoldDays.toFixed(2).padStart(7),
    value.eras.map((era) => signed(era).padStart(7)).join(" "),
  ].join

h4Levels
      .filter((candidate) =>
        candidate.direction === direction
        && isKeyVolumeLevelActive(candidate, time)
        && intervalDistance(
          key.zoneLow,
          key.zoneHigh,
          candidate.zoneLow,
          candidate.zoneHigh,
        ) <= confluenceTolerance,
      )
      .sort

swings
    .filter((swing) =>
      swing.type === type
      && swing.confirmIndex <= index
      && swing.index >= index - lookback)
    .sort

swings
    .filter((swing) => swing.type === type && swing.confirmIndex <= index && predicate(swing))
    .sort

levels
    .filter((level) =>
      level.direction !== direction
      && isKeyVolumeLevelActive(level, time)
      && (!sourceTfs || sourceTfs.includes(level.sourceTf))
      && (direction === "long" ? level.price > entry : level.price < entry)
      && (beyond == null || (direction === "long" ? level.price > beyond : level.price < beyond))
    )
    .map((level) => level.price)
    .sort

levels
    .filter((level) =>
      level.direction !== direction
      && isKeyVolumeLevelActive(level, time)
      && (!sourceTfs || sourceTfs.includes(level.sourceTf))
      && (direction === "long" ? level.price > entry : level.price < entry)
      && (beyond == null || (direction === "long" ? level.price > beyond : level.price < beyond))
    )
    .map

baseCandles
    .filter((candle) =>
      Number.isFinite(candle.open)
      && Number.isFinite(candle.high)
      && Number.isFinite(candle.low)
      && Number.isFinite(candle.close)
      && candle.high >= candle.low,
    )
    .sort

[
    `gross avg reward/fail=${avgGrossWin.toFixed(2)}R/${avgGrossFail.toFixed(2)}R`
      + ` (${avgGrossFail > 0 ? (avgGrossWin / avgGrossFail).toFixed(2) : "n/a"}x)`,
    `net avg reward/fail=${avgNetWin.toFixed(2)}R/${avgNetFail.toFixed(2)}R`
      + ` (${avgNetFail > 0 ? (avgNetWin / avgNetFail).toFixed(2) : "n/a"}x)`,
    `all-in-risk reward/fail=${avgAllInWin.toFixed(2)}R/${avgAllInFail.toFixed(2)}R`
      + ` (${avgAllInFail > 0 ? (avgAllInWin / avgAllInFail).toFixed(2) : "n/a"}x)`,
    `target gross range=${targetRewards[0]?.toFixed(2) ?? "n/a"}R`
      + `..${targetRewards.at(-1)?.toFixed(2) ?? "n/a"}R`,
    `stop gross range=${stopFailures[0]?.toFixed(2) ?? "n/a"}R`
      + `..${stopFailures.at(-1)?.toFixed(2) ?? "n/a"}R`,
    `cost median/max=${median(costs).toFixed(2)}R/${(costs.at(-1) ?? 0).toFixed(2)}R`,
  ].join

[...grouped.values()].map((units) => ({
    symbol: units[0].symbol,
    dir: units[0].dir,
    entryTime: Math.min(...units.map((t) => t.entryTime)),
    exitTime: units[0].exitTime,
    exitReason: units[0].exitReason,
    units: units.sort((a, b) => a.entryTime - b.entryTime),
    netR: sum(units.map((t) => t.netR)),
  })).sort
